raw_segments.text: Camillo, then list to me. This follows if you will not change your purpose but undergo
this flight make for Cecilia, and there present yourself and your fair princess, for so I
see she must be, for Leance, she shall be habited as it becomes the partner of your
Methinks I see Leance opening his free arms and weeping his welcomes forth, asks thee,
the sun, forgiveness, as twear I T.H. father's person, kisses the hands of your fresh princess,
o'er and o'er divides him, twixt his unkindness and his kindness. T.H., when he chides to
hell and bids the other grow faster than thought or time.
